---
title: "Quarterly pantry report"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
params:
  this_q: "FY27 Q1"
  last_q: "FY26 Q1"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

this_q <- params$this_q
last_q <- params$last_q

visits <- read_rds("data-clean/visits.rds")

# Stop with a clear message if a quarter is mistyped or not in the data yet
missing_q <- setdiff(c(this_q, last_q), visits$quarter)
if (length(missing_q) > 0) {
  stop(
    "No visits found for ",
    str_flatten_comma(missing_q),
    ". Check the this_q and last_q parameters."
  )
}

pct_change <- function(new, old) {
  scales::percent((new - old) / old, accuracy = 1)
}

report_visits <- visits |>
  filter(quarter %in% c(this_q, last_q))

totals <- report_visits |>
  summarize(
    households = n_distinct(hh_id),
    visits = n(),
    people = sum(hh_size),
    .by = quarter
  )

now <- filter(totals, quarter == this_q)
before <- filter(totals, quarter == last_q)
```

## `r this_q`

Our pantries served **`r scales::comma(now$households)` households** this quarter, compared with `r scales::comma(before$households)` in `r last_q`. That's `r scales::comma(now$visits)` visits and `r scales::comma(now$people)` people served.

## By site

```{r}
this_hh <- str_c(this_q, " households")
last_hh <- str_c(last_q, " households")

report_visits |>
  summarize(
    "{this_hh}" := n_distinct(hh_id[quarter == this_q]),
    "{last_hh}" := n_distinct(hh_id[quarter == last_q]),
    "{this_q} visits" := sum(quarter == this_q),
    .by = site_name
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Change = pct_change(.data[[this_hh]], .data[[last_hh]]),
    .after = all_of(last_hh)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(.data[[this_hh]])) |>
  rename(Site = site_name) |>
  knitr::kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```
